headline: The clap test now coaches you while you slap
lede: A shipped-phone review of CLAP TEST found seven ways the screen stayed quiet about what went wrong. All seven landed: the mic level is visible mid-test, the two-second rhythm shows itself, dead takes say so plainly, verdicts persist on the phone, and the whole page speaks to screen readers and buzzes in the hand.

notes.text: Live mic meter + TOO QUIET flash, per-slap gap readout (~2 s aim), zero-tap hint that names START, last-5 verdict history on the attract screen, aria-live verdict + vibrate, and a dead-vs-partial note when nothing pairs.

claptestplay now drives a second, off-tempo run (1.6/2.4 s) — honest green survives human rhythm variance, not just the baked cadence. recordcheck 152/152 with 14 new pins; can-fail proven by hand-mutant.
Busy boxes starve rAF and distort the take clock past ±50 ms — the suite now measures its own frame rate and SKIPS exactly the time-shaped gates instead of going red or lying quiet.
